content.instruction: Write a job application. You are applying for an under-secretary-general position at the United Nations. Tell about your experience in multilateral diplomacy, peacekeeping, and promoting sustainable development goals. Also describe how you have led extensive reform processes and built consensus between different member states. Length about 400 words.
